$comment: Single source of truth for scope -> stage routing, iteration bounds and failure categories.
Read by scripts/lib/pipeline-config.mjs; every consumer (scripts/run-pipeline.mjs, the
workflow skills, the docs) must derive its routing from this file rather than restating it.
scripts/test/pipeline-config.test.mjs fails the build when a copy drifts.
stages[].kind is the TARGET classification from docs/architecture.md (llm | tool | gate).
stages[].kind says who performs it: llm is the workflow skill itself, tool is a CLI, gate is a
decision with an exit code. stages[].tool names the CLI when one exists.
Ported 1:1 from the SUBCHAINS constant that used to live in scripts/run-pipeline.mjs and
from the scope descriptions in schemas/revision.schema.json. Semantics were not changed.

orchestrator.description: scope the change; open/route the revision
orchestrator.label: route

skillValidator.description: validate the skill pack against the target API
skillValidator.label: validate-skills

visualAnalyzer.description: ratios, anchors, regions from the reference
visualAnalyzer.label: visual-analysis

architectureMapper.description: map regions to primitives + theme tokens
architectureMapper.label: architecture

testRender.description: compile + render + diff + loop verdict, one call  <- mechanical
testRender.label: compile-render

iterate.label: iterate
iterate.description: ask whether the loop may take another pass (0 ready / 2 revise / 3 blocked)

exact-diff.summary: Binary pixel diff against the parent revision.
exact-diff.rule: render-and-diff --against parent reports mismatchPx == 0 on every page (tools/visual-diff at pixel threshold 0 — the AE == 0 this gate is named after); the metric is quoted verbatim in visual-review, never paraphrased.

region-diff.summary: Region-aware pixel diff against the parent revision.
region-diff.rule: tools/visual-diff/bin/region-diff.mjs --changed <ids> cuts every region out of visual-analysis.json and compares it; any region outside --changed carrying mismatched pixels exits 2. The per-region numbers land in region-diff-stats.json and are quoted into gate.regions[], never paraphrased.

visual-review.summary: Layer-by-layer review against the reference image.
visual-review.rule: Per docs/visual-accuracy-contract.md; APPROVE only when every mismatch is at most MINOR or ACCEPTED_LIMITATION. The page percentage is a signal and never a pass/fail here — a rasterised reference never scores zero — so the location of the difference comes from region-diff, whose per-region concentration ranks where to look.

skillValidation.summary: Skill validation is enforced on EVERY scope, including the scopes whose chain has no skillValidator stage.
skillValidation.onHalt: the render process exits with status 4 (the halt contract the skill validation gate enforces)

new.description: First revision of a project (revision-001, or parentRevisionId null). Runs the full chain.

visual-change.description: The render must look different from the parent (new layout, swapped fonts, new icon set, restyled section). Compared against the reference image.

refactor-only.description: The render must look IDENTICAL to the parent (class rename, helper extraction, data-spec split, dependency upgrade, package move).

data-only.description: A field inside <doc-kind>-data.json changed (email, phone, heading, list item). Java, assets and theme unchanged.

asset-only.description: An entry inside asset-request.json changed (icon set swap, font family swap). Java, data and theme unchanged.

theme-only.description: A token inside the theme bundle changed (palette colour, type scale, decoration glyph, spacing token). Cross-cutting visual effect, so reviewed against the reference rather than diffed against the parent.

$comment: The four user gestures, each an installable skill. Not a 1:1 mapping onto stages:
a stage like visualAnalyzer belongs to more than one workflow, and approve/review run
no pipeline chain at all. `scopes` records which scopes a workflow can open.

create-template.summary: Reference in, template out; loops until ready for approval.

revise-template.summary: Change an existing template as a new revision, under the narrowest scope that fits.

review-template.summary: Measure and judge the current render; opens no revision.

approve-template.summary: DRAFT to APPROVED, supersede the previous, publish the bundle.

$materialMovePercent: Page-difference movement, in percentage points, below which a pass bought nothing.
Two consecutive attempts on one cause that each move less than this are reported as
stalled by scripts/lib/iteration-status.mjs. Evidence, not a bound: it does not end the
loop, because a threshold nobody measured should not be the thing that ends one.
0.25 is a quarter of a percentage point of the page - on an A4 render at 1240x1753,
about 5,400 pixels, which is a line of text moving by two pixels.
